subject: Slateworks AP onboarding: remittance/SFTP, TIN/EORI crosswalk, PO acknowledgement
messages:
From: Elaine Nguyen <accounts-payable@slateworks.co>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai
Cc: ap-ops@slateworks.co
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 18:12:00 +0100
Subject: Vendor enrollment: Slateworks needs Redwood as vendor in procurement

Hi Ava,

We need to enroll Redwood Inference as a vendor in Slateworks' procurement system ahead of the upcoming PO (anticipated next week). To complete enrollment our AP team needs:

- Legal name + DBA
- U.S. TIN / EU VAT or EORI (depending on billing entity)
- Bank remittance information (IBAN/SWIFT) and remit email
- A completed AP onboarding packet (we prefer PDF)
- A sample PO-ACK format (CSV or UBL) so our PO engine can auto-acknowledge

Can you provide the packet and confirm whether Redwood will accept reverse-charge (EU) on services, or whether a VAT-registered invoice will be provided? Also, do you support SFTP drop for invoice ingestion?

Thanks,
Elaine Nguyen\Accounts Payable Manager\Slateworks Ltd.

Attachment: PO_terms_template.docx (referenced)

From: ava_chen@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Nguyen <accounts-payable@slateworks.co>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: Slateworks needs Redwood as vendor in procurement

Hi Elaine — thanks for the note. Putting our AP/Finance folks on copy.

Summary: we can be onboarded as a vendor and support SFTP invoice ingestion (SFTP + API), provide VAT/EORI details for EU billing, and can supply a PO-ACK CSV. Please find our AP onboarding packet attached. Quick answers below, full details in the packet (attached):

- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc. (DBA: Redwood Inference)
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) — we also have an EU VAT-registered subsidiary for EU invoices.
- U.S. TIN: 12-3456789 (see W9 attached)
- EU VAT/EORI: GB999999973000 (if you will receive invoices billed to our UK entity) — confirm which billing entity you want on the PO
- Bank remittance: Deutsche Bank IBAN DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 / SWIFT DEUTDEFF (we can provide alternate USD routing on request)
- Remit email for automated receipts: ap-inbound@redwood.ai
- SFTP ingestion: yes — we can drop both PDF invoices and structured CSV/UBL. Sample SFTP path: sftp://upload.slatego.co/inbound/redwood/ (we'll coordinate credentials)
- PO-ACK: attached is a Sample_PO_ack.csv with the fields our system can emit (PO number, line ack, qty accepted, unit price, ship-to ID). If you need UBL, we can provide a small adapter.

Next steps:
1) Which billing entity should be on the PO (US vs EU)?
2) Please confirm required PO-ACK fields and whether your engine needs a specific CSV delimiter/encoding.
3) If Slateworks wants SFTP, can you provision a write-only account for redwood@redwood.ai and share host/key details?

I'll defer to Marcus for vendor-record creation once you confirm the entity.

Best,
Ava Chen\Solutions Lead, Partnerships\Redwood Inference\ava_chen@redwood.ai\Attachment: Slateworks_AP_Packet_20270901.pdf; Sample_PO_ack.csv; W9_Slateworks.pdf

From: Elaine Nguyen <accounts-payable@slateworks.co>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai
Cc: ap-ops@slateworks.co
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 14:27:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: Slateworks needs Redwood as vendor in procurement

Hi Ava — appreciate the quick turnaround and the packet. A few clarifications from AP/OPS: 

- Slateworks prefers the billed entity to match the PO to avoid FX rebooking. We'll put the PO under the EU-registered entity if you can provide VAT invoices. Can you confirm the EU VAT invoice header and sample VAT number to appear on invoices?

- For PO-ACK, our ingestion wants CSV UTF-8 with a pipe (|) delimiter and the following header order: PO_NUMBER|LINE_NUMBER|ACK_STATUS|QTY_ACK|UNIT_PRICE|CURRENCY|DELIVERY_DATE. Can Redwood generate that from your system?

- For SFTP: yes, we'll create a directory for /inbound/redwood/ with a write-only key. Our security team requires SSH public key + a contact for key rotation. Also we need to validate file naming convention: slateworks_PO_<PO>#_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf or .csv

- Quick VAT question: in cases where reverse-charge applies, Slateworks will apply reverse-charge but we still need to see VAT registration on your invoice for our records. If you cannot supply an EU VAT invoice, we may need to route payment to the US entity and gross up for VAT.

Can you confirm these points and share the contact for key exchange?

Thanks,
Elaine

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Nguyen <accounts-payable@slateworks.co>
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: Slateworks needs Redwood as vendor in procurement

Hi Elaine — Marcus from Finance here. Points below and action items attached.

Confirmations:
- EU VAT header: "Redwood Inference UK Ltd" (billing entity)
- VAT / EORI: GB999999973000 — this should appear on EU invoices.
- CSV PO-ACK: we can emit a pipe-delimited UTF-8 file in the exact header order you listed. We'll add an additional field "ACK_TIMESTAMP" if helpful (optional).
- SFTP key exchange: please provision the write-only directory and send the SSH public key. Our contact for key rotation and technical ops is: infra-ops@redwood.ai (sec ops team). We'll provide a specific deploy key for the Slateworks directory.

Action items for Slateworks:
1) Confirm billing entity (you indicated EU is preferred — we'll expect POs to Redwood Inference UK Ltd)
2) Create SFTP directory /inbound/redwood/ and provide the host + sample key upload URL
3) Confirm file naming convention; we are okay with slateworks_PO_<PO>#_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf or .csv

If you confirm EU billing, we'll mark the vendor record as VAT-registered and ensure invoices include the VAT number. Once the first PO lands we will return the PO-ACK within 1 business hour for standard orders.

Attached: vendor_creation_checklist.txt (internal copy) — cc'ing Laura for procurement follow-up.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
